text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I spot Oguri Cap and Mejiro Ryan heading somewhere in their tracksuits.
choice_data_list: Are you going to train together?
Are you going to train together?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: We're actually going to sow some tomato seeds.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's to help the director. I was originally planning on doing it alone, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oguri insisted it's too big a job for one person and offered to help!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I've sown seeds before in my hometown.
choice_data_list: Do you want me to lend a hand too?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Would you really? That'd be a big help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks a lot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's just like they say—when three's the pair, there's no weighted barbell you can't bear.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Wow… I've never heard that saying before.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's start by plowing the field.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: There are some weeds around here, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: We'd better pull them first if we want the plants to grow up strong.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Working crouched down is going to take some endurance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Crouching… That's basically a squat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: This is gonna be great for my hamstrings!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I think you're onto something there. Ham would go really well with tomatoes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You bet! Nothing beats tomatoes when it comes to soothing sore and tired muscles!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Let's get this done so we can enjoy our ham and tomatoes.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: There's so much to do, though. Trainer, where should we start?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's start with the weeds. Then Ryan, can you till the soil?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: On it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap and I go around pulling every weed we see.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Whew, my knees are trembling… This is more demanding than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's just your muscles crying out with joy!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Muscles… have voices?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Interesting. I've never heard them speak to me before, though…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Move around while crouching like that, and your muscles will start to sing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Anyway, it's sowing time! Make sure you keep an ear out for their cries of rapture!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of voices they have…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I continue sowing tomato seeds, listening to the pair somehow go back and forth on two different pages.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Okay. I'm going to till the soil. I'll leave the weeds to you, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You mean the squats, right? Say no more!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Uh, well… I actually meant pulling the weeds…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Was I unclear?
choice_data_list: I think you got the message across.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You think so? Well, I guess I'll just worry about my own job.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Oguri Cap and I plow the soil.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Whew, this is pretty grueling… I don't think my arms can take it any longer…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's proof your muscles are growing. Nice job, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's the same over here. My hamstrings are pumping way more than normal!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah? I don't really get it, but I guess you must really like ham and tomato.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm a big fan too, so I can see why you're excited. I can't wait for the harvest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I continue sowing tomato seeds, listening to the pair somehow go back and forth on two different pages.
